name: Abiding Hex
text: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

name: Accelerated Growth
text: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

name: Accelerated Growth II
text: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

name: Acrimony
text: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Adhesive Grenades I
text: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

name: Adhesive Grenades II
text: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

name: Adhesive Grenades III
text: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land. Grenades from Supported Skills have longer cooldowns, and a chance to detonate an additional time.

name: Admixture
text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

name: Advancing Storm
text: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

name: Aftershock I
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

name: Aftershock II
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

name: Aftershock III
text: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills a chance to create an Aftershock as well as increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time

name: Ahn's Citadel
text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

name: Ailith's Chimes
text: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

name: Alignment I
text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Alignment II
text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Alignment III
text: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

name: Amanamu's Tithe
text: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

name: Ambrosia
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

name: Ambrosia II
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

name: Ambush
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

name: Ammo Conservation I
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

name: Ammo Conservation II
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

name: Ammo Conservation III
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

name: Ancestral Aid
text: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

name: Ancestral Call I
text: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Ancestral Call II
text: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Ancestral Call III
text: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every second, at the cost of a damage penalty. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Arakaali's Lust
text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

name: Arbiter's Ignition
text: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

name: Arbiter's Reach
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.

name: Arcane Surge
text: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

name: Arjun's Medal
text: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.

name: Armour Break I
text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

name: Armour Break II
text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

name: Armour Break III
text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

name: Armour Demolisher I
text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

name: Armour Demolisher II
text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

name: Armour Explosion
text: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

name: Arms Length
text: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

name: Astral Projection
text: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

name: Atalui's Bloodletting
text: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

name: Atziri's Allure
text: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

name: Atziri's Call
text: DNT-UNUSED Supports Spells you use yourself which Hit enemies. On Critical Hit with supported Spells, Trigger Atziri's Storm at the location of the nearest enemy.

name: Atziri's Communion
text: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

name: Atziri's Impatience
text: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Auto Reload
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Barbs I
text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Barbs II
text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Barbs III
text: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

name: Battershout
text: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

name: Behead I
text: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

name: Behead II
text: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

name: Bhatair's Vengeance
text: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Bidding I
text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Bidding II
text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Bidding III
text: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

name: Biting Frost I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Biting Frost II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Blazing Critical
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

name: Bleed I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

name: Bleed IV
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

name: Blind I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

name: Blind II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

name: Blindside
text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

name: Bloodlust
text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

name: Bone Shrapnel
text: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

name: Boundless Energy I
text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

name: Boundless Energy II
text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

name: Bounty I
text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

name: Bounty II
text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

name: Brambleslam
text: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

name: Branching Fissures I
text: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

name: Branching Fissures II
text: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

name: Breachlord's Amalgam
text: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

name: Breachlord's Rift
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

name: Break Endurance
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when it Fully Breaks an enemy's Armour.

name: Break Posture
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.

name: Brink I
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

name: Brink II
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

name: Brittle Armour
text: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

name: Brutality I
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

name: Brutality II
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

name: Brutality III
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

name: Brutus' Brain
text: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Burgeon I
text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

name: Burgeon II
text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

name: Burning Inscription
text: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

name: Bursting Plague
text: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

name: Cadence
text: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

name: Caltrops
text: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

name: Cannibalism I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

name: Cannibalism II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

name: Catalysing Elements
text: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

name: Catha's Brilliance
text: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Catharsis
text: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

name: Chain I
text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Chain II
text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Chain III
text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

name: Chaos Attunement
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

name: Chaos Mastery
text: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Chaotic Freeze
text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Charge Profusion I
text: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

name: Charge Profusion II
text: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

name: Charged Mark
text: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

name: Charged Shots I
text: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

name: Charged Shots II
text: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

name: Charm Bounty
text: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

name: Cirel's Cultivation
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Clarity I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Clarity II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Clash
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

name: Close Combat I
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

name: Close Combat II
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

name: Cold Attunement
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

name: Cold Exposure
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it inflicts Freeze.

name: Cold Mastery
text: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Cold Penetration
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

name: Combo Finisher I
text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

name: Combo Finisher II
text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

name: Commandment
text: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

name: Commiserate
text: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

name: Compressed Duration I
text: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

name: Compressed Duration II
text: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

name: Concentrated Area
text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

name: Concoct I
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

name: Concoct II
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

name: Concussive Runes
text: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

name: Concussive Spells
text: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

name: Considered Casting
text: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

name: Controlled Destruction
text: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

name: Controlled Hazard
text: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

name: Cool Headed
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Cooldown Recovery I
text: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Cooldown Recovery II
text: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

name: Corpse Conservation
text: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

name: Corrosion
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

name: Corrupting Cry I
text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

name: Corrupting Cry II
text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

name: Coursing Current
text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

name: Crackling Barrier
text: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

name: Crater
text: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Crazed Minions
text: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

name: Creeping Chill
text: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

name: Crescendo I
text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

name: Crescendo II
text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

name: Crescendo III
text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

name: Crystalline Shards
text: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

name: Culling Strike I
text: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

name: Culling Strike II
text: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

name: Culmination I
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Culmination II
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Cursed Ground
text: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

name: Danse Macabre
text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

name: Daresso's Passion
text: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

name: Dauntless
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

name: Daze
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

name: Dazing Cry
text: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.

name: Dazzle
text: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills always hit Dazed Enemies, but Consume Daze on Hit, and cannot themselves inflict Daze. Cannot Support Skills which Consume Daze.

name: Deadly Herald
text: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

name: Deadly Poison I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

name: Deadly Poison II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

name: Deadly Resolve
text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

name: Deathmarch
text: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

name: Decaying Hex
text: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.

name: Deep Cuts I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

name: Deep Cuts II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

name: Deep Freeze
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

name: Defy I
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

name: Defy II
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

name: Delayed Reaction
text: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

name: Deliberation
text: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

name: Derange
text: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

name: Desperation
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while Surrounded.

name: Devastate
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to apply Broken Armour to enemies when causing a Heavy Stun to enemies.

name: Dialla's Desire
text: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

name: Direstrike I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Direstrike II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Doedre's Undoing
text: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at enemies that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

name: Dominus' Grasp
text: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

name: Double Barrel I
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

name: Double Barrel II
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

name: Double Barrel III
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Drain Ailments
text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

name: Dreamer's Knell
text: DNT-UNUSED Ezomyte Four

name: Durability
text: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Echoing Cry
text: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

name: Efficiency I
text: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Efficiency II
text: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Einhar's Beastrite
text: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Electrocute
text: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

name: Electromagnetism
text: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

name: Elemental Armament I
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

name: Elemental Armament II
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

name: Elemental Armament III
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

name: Elemental Army
text: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Elemental Discharge
text: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.

name: Elemental Focus
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

name: Embitter
text: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

name: Empowered Sparks I
text: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

name: Empowered Sparks II
text: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

name: Encroaching Ground
text: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

name: Enduring Impact I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

name: Enduring Impact II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

name: Energy Barrier
text: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.

name: Energy Capacitor
text: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

name: Energy Retention
text: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

name: Enervation
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to regenerate mana on shocking an enemy. Cannot support skills which create Minions, or skills used by Totems or Traps.

name: Enraged Warcry I
text: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

name: Enraged Warcry II
text: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

name: Eonyr's Thunder
text: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.

name: Escalating Poison
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

name: Esh's Prowess
text: Supports Lightning Skills that Hit, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not Support Skills which do not have levels.

name: Esh's Radiance
text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

name: Essence Harvest
text: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

name: Eternal Flame I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

name: Eternal Flame II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

name: Eternal Flame III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

name: Eternal Mark
text: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

name: Excise
text: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Excoriate
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Melee Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

name: Execrate
text: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Execute I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

name: Execute II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

name: Execute III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

name: Expand
text: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Expanse
text: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Exploit Weakness
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

name: Exposing Cry
text: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

name: Extraction
text: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

name: Fan The Flames
text: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

name: Fan The Flames II
text: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

name: Feeding Frenzy I
text: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Ferocity
text: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.

name: Fiery Death
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

name: Fire Attunement
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

name: Fire Exposure
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

name: Fire Mastery
text: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Fire Penetration I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

name: Fire Penetration II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

name: First Blood
text: Supports Attacks. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict Bleeding on Hitting full Life Enemies.

name: Fist Of Kalguur
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

name: Fist of War I
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

name: Fist of War II
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

name: Fist of War III
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

name: Flame Pillar
text: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Flamepierce
text: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

name: Flow
text: Supports Skills which require Combo to use. Supported Skills lose their Combo stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any Combo.

name: Fluke
text: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

name: Focused Curse
text: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

name: Font of Blood
text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

name: Font of Mana
text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

name: Font of Rage
text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Rage which will Leech Rage to Allies within it.

name: Fork
text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

name: Fortress I
text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

name: Fortress II
text: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

name: Freeze
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

name: Freezefork
text: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

name: Frenzied Riposte
text: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

name: Fresh Clip I
text: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

name: Fresh Clip II
text: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

name: Frost Nexus
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

name: Frostfire
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze or Ignite.

name: Frozen Spite
text: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Frozen Vortex
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create an icy vortex on Shattering an enemy.

name: Fusillade
text: DNT-UNUSED Supports Bow Attacks you use yourself. Supported Attacks fire multiple projectiles into the air,

name: Gambleshot
text: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

name: Garukhan's Resolve
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

name: Glacier
text: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

name: Gorge
text: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

name: Greatwood II
text: DNT Supports Skills which create Totems, limiting their active Totem count to one but granting significant benefits for supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not support Skills used by Minions.

name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

name: Haemocrystals
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

name: Hardy Totems I
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

name: Hardy Totems II
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

name: Harmonic Remnants I
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

name: Harmonic Remnants II
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

name: Hayoxi's Fulmination
text: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

name: Healing Runes
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to lose Runic Ward and heal nearby allies based on the Ward lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

name: Heavy Swing
text: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

name: Heft
text: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

name: Heightened Accuracy I
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

name: Heightened Accuracy II
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

name: Heightened Charges
text: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

name: Heightened Curse
text: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

name: Helbrym's Hide
text: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

name: Her Declaration
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

name: Herbalism I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

name: Herbalism II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

name: Hex Bloom
text: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

name: Hinder
text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

name: Hit and Run
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

name: Hoarfrost
text: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Supported Skills create chilling areas which deal Cold Damage over time instead of creating Ice Crystals.

name: Hobble
text: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Hobble Bleeding Enemies based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

name: Holy Descent
text: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

name: Hourglass
text: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Hulking Minions
text: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

name: Ice Bite I
text: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Ice Bite II
text: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

name: Icicle
text: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

name: Ignite I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

name: Ignite II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

name: Ignite III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

name: Immolate
text: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

name: Impact Shockwave
text: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

name: Impale
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

name: Impending Doom
text: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

name: Incision
text: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

name: Inexorable Critical I
text: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

name: Inexorable Critical II
text: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

name: Infernal Legion I
text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Infernal Legion II
text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Infernal Legion III
text: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

name: Infusion
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, making the Buff they grant more powerful.

name: Inhibitor
text: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

name: Innervate
text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.

name: Intense Agony
text: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

name: Invocation
text: Supports Spell skills, causing them to reduce the cast time of other skills when used. Cannot support Totem skills, Channelling skills, Triggering skills, instant skills, or skills with a Reservation.

name: Ixchel's Torment
text: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

name: Jagged Ground I
text: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

name: Jagged Ground II
text: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

name: Kalisa's Crescendo
text: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

name: Kaom's Madness
text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
text: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

name: Knockback
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

name: Kulemak's Dominion
text: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

name: Kurgal's Leash
text: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

name: Last Gasp
text: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

name: Lasting Ground
text: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

name: Lasting Shock
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

name: Leverage
text: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased chance to Critically Hit against Immobilised Enemies.

name: Life Bounty
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.

name: Life Drain
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

name: Life Leech I
text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

name: Life Leech II
text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

name: Life Leech III
text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

name: Lifetap
text: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

name: Lightning Attunement
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

name: Lightning Exposure
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

name: Lightning Mastery
text: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Lightning Penetration
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.
