text: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Living Lightning II
text: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Lockdown
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

name: Long Fuse I
text: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

name: Long Fuse II
text: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

name: Longshot I
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

name: Longshot II
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

name: Loyalty
text: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

name: Magnetic Remnants
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

name: Magnified Area I
text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

name: Magnified Area II
text: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

name: Maim
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

name: Malady
text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

name: Mana Bounty
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

name: Mana Flare
text: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

name: Mana Leech
text: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

name: Mark for Death
text: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

name: Mark for Death II
text: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

name: Mark of Siphoning
text: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

name: Mark of Siphoning II
text: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

name: Meat Shield I
text: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

name: Meat Shield II
text: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

name: Medved's Felling
text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

name: Minion Instability
text: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

name: Minion Mastery
text: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Minion Pact I
text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

name: Minion Pact II
text: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

name: Minion Splash I
text: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

name: Minion Splash II
text: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

name: Mobility
text: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

name: Momentum
text: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

name: Morgana's Tempest
text: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

name: Mórrigan's Insight
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

name: Multishot I
text: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

name: Multishot II
text: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

name: Murderous Intent
text: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

name: Muster
text: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

name: Mysticism I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Mysticism II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Nadir
text: DNT-UNUSED Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.

name: Neural Overload
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

name: Nimble Reload
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

name: Nova Projectiles I
text: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

name: Nova Projectiles II
text: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Oisín's Oath
text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

name: Olroth's Conviction
text: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

name: Olroth's Hubris
text: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

name: Opening Move
text: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

name: Outmaneuver
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Break Armour against Parried Enemies.

name: Overabundance I
text: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

name: Overabundance II
text: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

name: Overabundance III
text: Supports Skills which have a Limit, doubling that Limit, but Cursing yourself on Supported Skill use. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit". Cannot support Persistent Skills.

name: Overcharge
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

name: Overextend
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

name: Overreach
text: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

name: Paquate's Pact
text: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

name: Payload
text: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

name: Perfected Endurance
text: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

name: Perfection
text: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

name: Perpetual Charge
text: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

name: Persistent Ground I
text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

name: Persistent Ground II
text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

name: Persistent Ground III
text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

name: Physical Mastery
text: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Pierce I
text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

name: Pierce II
text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

name: Pierce III
text: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

name: Pin I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

name: Pin II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

name: Pin III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

name: Pinpoint Critical
text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

name: Poison I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

name: Poison II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

name: Poison III
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

name: Poison Spores
text: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

name: Potent Exposure
text: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

name: Potential
text: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

name: Practical Magic I
text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

name: Practical Magic II
text: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

name: Practiced Combo
text: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

name: Precision I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

name: Precision II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

name: Premeditation
text: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to deal more damage.

name: Profanity I
text: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

name: Profanity II
text: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

name: Projectile Acceleration I
text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

name: Projectile Acceleration II
text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

name: Projectile Acceleration III
text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

name: Projectile Deceleration I
text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

name: Projectile Deceleration II
text: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

name: Prolonged Duration I
text: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

name: Prolonged Duration II
text: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

name: Prolonged Duration III
text: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration significantly longer while applying a cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

name: Prototype Seventeen
text: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

name: Punch Through
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

name: Pursuit I
text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Pursuit II
text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Pursuit III
text: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

name: Quill Burst
text:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

name: Rage I
text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

name: Rage II
text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

name: Rage III
text: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

name: Rageforged I
text: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

name: Rageforged II
text: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

name: Raging Cry
text: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

name: Rakiata's Flow
text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

name: Rally
text: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

name: Rapid Attacks I
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

name: Rapid Attacks II
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

name: Rapid Attacks III
text: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

name: Rapid Casting I
text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

name: Rapid Casting II
text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

name: Rapid Casting III
text: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

name: Ratha's Assault
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

name: Rearm I
text: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

name: Rearm II
text: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

name: Refraction I
text: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

name: Refraction II
text: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

name: Refraction III
text: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

name: Reinforced Totems I
text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

name: Reinforced Totems II
text: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

name: Relentless Rage
text: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

name: Remnant Potency I
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

name: Remnant Potency II
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

name: Remnant Potency III
text: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

name: Rending Apex
text: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

name: Retaliate I
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Retaliate II
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Retreat I
text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Retreat II
text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Retreat III
text: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

name: Reverberate
text: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

name: Ricochet I
text: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

name: Ricochet II
text: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

name: Ricochet III
text: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, causing those Projectiles to Chain when impacting terrain, at the cost of any additional Projectiles, as well as causing them to always Pierce.

name: Rigwald's Ferocity
text: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

name: Rime
text: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.

name: Rip
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

name: Rising Tempest
text: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

name: Ritualistic Curse
text: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

name: Romira's Requital
text: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

name: Runeforged Blades
text: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

name: Runic Extraction
text: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

name: Runic Infusion
text: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

name: Rupture
text: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

name: Rusted Spikes
text: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

name: Ruthless
text: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

name: Sacrificial Lamb I
text: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

name: Sacrificial Lamb II
text: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

name: Sacrificial Offering
text: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

name: Salvo
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Scouring Flame
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

name: Searing Flame I
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

name: Searing Flame II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

name: Second Wind I
text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Second Wind II
text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Second Wind III
text: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: See Red
text: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.

name: Selfless Remnants
text: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

name: Seraph's Heart
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

name: Shock
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

name: Shock Conduction
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

name: Shock Conduction II
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

name: Shock Siphon
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

name: Shocking Leap
text: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

name: Short Fuse I
text: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

name: Short Fuse II
text: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

name: Sione's Temper
text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

name: Skittering Stone I
text: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

name: Skittering Stone II
text: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

name: Slow Potency
text: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

name: Soul Drain
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

name: Soulbreaker
text: Supports skills you use yourself, causing them to Trigger a Chaos Damage nova when breaking Enemy Energy Shield.

name: Spar
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

name: Spectral Volley
text: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

name: Spell Cascade
text: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

name: Spell Echo
text: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

name: Splinter Totem I
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

name: Splinter Totem II
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

name: Spreading Frost
text: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing them to Chill enemies near enemies they Freeze.

name: Static Shocks
text: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

name: Steadfast I
text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

name: Steadfast II
text: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

name: Stoicism I
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

name: Stoicism II
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

name: Stomping Ground
text: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

name: Stormchain
text: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

name: Stormfire
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

name: Streamlined Rounds
text: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

name: Strong Hearted
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Stun I
text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

name: Stun II
text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

name: Stun III
text: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

name: Styrn's Anthem
text: DNT Description

name: Styrn's Ferocity
text: Supports Shield Skills that Hit, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, and Physical Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

name: Styrn's Mountain
text: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

name: Supercritical
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

name: Swift Affliction I
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

name: Swift Affliction II
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

name: Swift Affliction III
text: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

name: Syzygy
text: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

name: Tacati's Ire
text: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

name: Tangmazu's Thurible
text: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

name: Tasalio's Rhythm
text: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

name: Tawhoa's Tending
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

name: Tear
text: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

name: Tecrod's Revenge
text: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

name: Tectonic Slams
text: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

name: Thornskin I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Thornskin II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Thrill of the Kill
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

name: Thrill of the Kill II
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

name: Tireless
text: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

name: Tremors
text: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.

name: Trickster's Shard
text: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

name: Tul's Avalanche
text: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

name: Tul's Stillness
text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

name: Tumult
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills consume a Frenzy Charge on use to powerfully Break Armour.

name: Uhtred's Augury
text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Uhtred's Constellation
text: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

name: Uhtred's Exodus
text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Uhtred's Omen
text: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

name: Uhtred's Rite
text: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

name: Unabating
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Unbending
text: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Unbreakable
text: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.

name: Undermine
text: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

name: Unerring Power
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

name: Unsteady Tempo
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Attacking with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first Attack in sequence inflicting Hobble on you. The second and third Attacks in sequence will powerfully scale chance to Critically Hit and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Untouchable
text: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Unyielding
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

name: Upheaval I
text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

name: Upheaval II
text: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

name: Upwelling I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Upwelling II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Urgent Totems I
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

name: Urgent Totems II
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

name: Urgent Totems III
text: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

name: Uruk's Smelting
text: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

name: Uul-Netol's Embrace
text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

name: Vanguard I
text: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

name: Vanguard II
text: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

name: Varashta's Blessing
text: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Verglas
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

name: Vilenta's Propulsion
text: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

name: Vitality I
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Vitality II
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

name: Volatile Power
text: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are Empowered, you gain Volatility.

name: Volatility
text: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

name: Volcanic Eruption
text: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

name: Volt
text: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

name: Vorana's Siege
text: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

name: Vruun's Aftermath
text: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

name: Vruun's Inevitability
text: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

name: Warm Blooded
text: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

name: Wildfire
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

name: Wildshards I
text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

name: Wildshards II
text: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

name: Wind Wave
text: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

name: Window of Opportunity I
text: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

name: Window of Opportunity II
text: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

name: Withering Touch
text: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

name: Xibaqua's Rending
text: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

name: Xoph's Pyre
text: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

name: Zarokh's Refrain
text: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

name: Zarokh's Revolt
text: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

name: Zenith I
text: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Zenith II
text: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

name: Zerphi's Infamy
text:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
